question: What does this arrow mean? (the green arrow above the demand curve, id: shift)

steps.title: What the arrow means
steps.say: This arrow shows demand moving to the right: at every price, buyers now want more.

ops.text:
This arrow: demand moves right —
at every price, buyers want more.

steps.title: Same price, more bought
steps.say: Follow the dashed line at price P1: on the old curve buyers want Q1, on the new curve they want more.

ops.text:
At the same price P1, buyers now want
more: the quantity demanded grows.
